I appreciate your valuable reply for this project.

Polaris shipping is happy with BV’s feedback on time.

Due to BV China's good relationship with shipyard, smooth NC/NS services for the previous 3 bulk carriers at SWS, and good relationship between Polaris Chairman and BV Korea CE, as the present, Polaris has no question about the BV service, but still has questions about whether Huanghai S/Y could handle this project smoothly in accordance with BV expertise.

In this regards, Polaris gave me the attached building specification and requested the following.

====== quoted (request from Polaris)==================

In the construction specification, please review whether there is any wrong rule application, or if there is any part that additional rules needs to be  application.

For your reference,

1)    Ships will not call in areas where NOx Tier III is applied, such as Europe or the United States.

Therefore, please review the specification, considering that NOx Tier III and EGCS are not applied.

   2)  BBC-HP to be applied. (KPO and MCC need to review it based on Korean Ship Safety Act.)

========== unquoted ===============

The previous Polaris project in SWS, because Polaris shipping did not specify BBC-HP, KPO & MCC had to suffer from additional working hours to review the requirements for BBC-HP.

This time, I have already asked clearly about whether to place an order with BBC-HP to Polaris, and I received a clear reply that the project will be based on BBC-HP.

So, it would be appreciated if you could check BBC-HP is included in SBC, considering that this project will be carried out with BBC-HP.

Your soonest reply would be highly appreciated.

_Best Regards,_

Dear Sangjin,

I will try to reply your questions as below:

SOLASII_2 Reg19 ==> ERS ???  No, this is for the SOLAS dangerous goods, since _Dangerous goods certificate_ will be issued by BV, no special notation.

G-EP(GPR(EU))  ==> GREEN PASSPORT ??? Yes, GREEN PASSPORT is applicable to ships flying the Flag of a non-EU member State.

G-ECO(BWM(T))  ==> BWT ??? Yes.

CLC(V,W) ==> LASHING-WW ??? Yes.

The CCS notation for the reference ship in Huanghai Shipyard is:

★CSA, Container Ship; PSPC(B), SOLASⅡ-2 Reg19, Loading Computer(S,I), In-water Survey, CLC(V,W) ★ CSM AUT-0, SCM, G-EP(GPR(EU)), G-ECO(BWM(T))

A comparison table between the CCS notation and BV notation for your easy reference:

Dear Sangjin,

Just in 06/2021 last month, through Huanghai S/Y’s solids supports, we did gain 4 (+2) x 1,800 TEU Feeders while the German Owner “Briese German” originally preferred to selected NK Class, see enclosed trailed mails in attachment just for reference.

These 4 (+2) x 1,800 TEU Feeders by “Briese German” are the repeat ship following one CCS classed ship in yard’s present order book for one local Chinese owner (by signing a tri-parties MOU among Owner/Yard/BV) , SDARI is the ship designer with quite numbers of same designed ships built in some other Chinese Yards.

Below BV Class Notations have been agreed to be applied to above “Briese German” projects,  please note that COMF-NOISE 3 and CLEANSHIP were applied in addition to those CCS Notations as assigned to the lead ship, corresponding to the NK Notations for which owner “Briese German” insisted to get during Ship Building Contract phase (Owner/Yard).

I + HULL, + MACH, Container ship, unrestricted navigation, + AUT-UMS, MON-SHAFT, CPS(WBT), BWT, INWATERSURVEY, LASHING-WW, COMF-NOISE 3, CLEANSHIP, GREEN PASSPORT, LI-HG-S2

And these BV Notations can be divided as:

|   |   |   |   |   |
|---|---|---|---|---|
|**Huanghai 1800TEU Container Vessel_BV Notations**|   |   |   |   |
|**No.**||**BV notation**|**Remark**|**BV Rules**|
|1|mandatory|+|construction marks|NR 467 Pt A, Ch 1, Sec 2.2|
|2|I|Class symbol|NR 467 Pt A, Ch 1, Sec 2.3.2|
|3|+ HULL|the hull|NR 467 Pt A, Ch 1, Sec 2.3.1|
|4|+ MACH|the machinery installations|NR 467 Pt A, Ch 1, Sec 2.3.1|
|5|Container ship|ships specially intended to carry containers in holds or on decks.|NR 467 Pt A, Ch 1, Sec 2, 4.2.6 / Part D, Chapter 2|
|6|unrestricted navigation|a ship intended to operate in any area and any period of the year.|NR 467 Pt A, Ch 1, Sec 2.5.2.1|
|7|Strongly recommended|CPS(WBT)|Coating performance standard|NR 467 Pt A, Ch 1, Sec 2, 6.15.4 / NR530|
|8|INWATERSURVEY|In-water survey|NR 467 Pt A, Ch 1, Sec 2, 6.14.3 / Pt F, Ch 11, Sec 3|
|9|+ AUT-UMS|Unattended machinery space|NR 467 Pt A, Ch 1, Sec 2, 6.4.2 / Part F, Ch 3 Sec 1|
|10|BWT|Ballast water treatment|NR 467 Pt A, Ch 1, Sec 2, 6.8.6 / Pt F, Ch 9, Sec 1 and Pt F, Ch 9, Sec 3|
|11|MON-SHAFT|Tailshaft monitoring system|NR 467 Pt A, Ch 1, Sec 2, 6.6.3 / Pt F, Ch 5, Sec 2 and  <br>in Ch 5, Sec 6|
|12|LASHING-WW|Container lashing equipment|NR 467 Pt A, Ch 1, Sec 2, 6.14.5 / Pt F, Ch 11, Sec 5|

The subject prospective 1,800 TEU feeder projects by Polaris Shipping are the repeat ships in this series,  by reading of your below mail, we have communicated with Huanghai S/Y accordingly, as advised, Polaris Shipping team is visiting yard now talking on the subject feeder orders, and **yard committed** to us for providing full supporting to BV.

Huanghai S/Y has quite long history, the main newbuilding projects in the past were consisted of MPV (Incl. Heavy Lift Carriers, bulk carriers, Feeders, Ro-Pax / Ro-Ferry and other specific types of ships (i.e. fishing vessels), details please see attachments. In general, Huanghai S/Y is standing on the top level among the tier II Chinese Yards,  with relative good quality and workmanship above the average of overall Chinese Yards… In past 2 years, Huanghai did not actively get too much orders, at current hot newbuilding boxship market, this has kept Huanghai S/Y standing on a very favorable position with big advantage (Vs other Chinese S/Ys) for offering ship owners with earlier delivery slots.

Besides above referred newly gained 1,800 TEU feeder series, BV had good newbuilding references at Huanghai S/Y with the major ones consisting of MPVs (Heavy Lift carriers) and Refrigerated Cargo ships as well as 1 x Cargo-Pax ship (the first passenger ship built in China to oversee owner complying with SRTP), moreover, there is one BV classed Passenger ship in yard’s present orderbook to one French Owner…

Hoping the above are helpful.
